title: Parking Period Charge Terms under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization: Moving-Out Periods and Military Discount
content:
For a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the parking notice amount charges for each of its two due dates (the parking notice due date and the in-flight parking draft's due date):

| Parking agreement status and dates | Military discount applied | Charge for the period |
|---|---|---|
| Moving out, planned vacate date on or before the period's due date | Yes or No | Nothing — that period is not charged |
| Any other case | Yes | Parking rent in force times one minus the military discount rate, rounded to the cent |
| Any other case | No | Parking rent in force as it stands |

The first row is tested first. A moving-out parking agreement whose planned vacate date is after the due date, or with no planned vacate date, falls in "any other case". The records read are the parking agreement's status, its planned vacate date, whether the military discount is applied, and the military discount rate of its parking class: Bluegate Uncovered Car Space 10%, Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) 10%, Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) 10%, Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) 10%, Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) 10%, Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage 10%.

**Hypothetical periods.**

- Rent in force $310.00, military discount applied: $310.00 times 0.90, $279.00.
- Rent in force $86.16, military discount applied: $77.544 is rounded to the cent, $77.54.
- Moving out with a planned vacate date of 24 July: a due date of 24 July is charged nothing; a due date of 23 July is charged.
